verdict.rationale: Codex is documented as a general coding agent that can inspect code, edit files, and run local development tools and commands in the CLI (codex-docs-8, codex-docs-9, codex-docs-30). It can also run delegated tasks in cloud environments and return a diff or pull request (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-5, codex-docs-6), which implies it could do test writing, lint fixing, conflict resolution, and dependency updates. However, none of those four tasks is explicitly documented or shown hands-on, and codex-docs-4 covers configuring environment dependencies, not updating them. Missing for 10: explicit docs or examples of test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, and dependency upgrades, plus independent hands-on corroboration of each.
